# About This Volume {.unnumbered .unlisted}

This is **Volume 3 of 3** of *Biostatistics Practicum*, the
industry-practice supplement. The book is also published whole, as
a single continuously numbered site, at
<https://practicum.rgtlab.org>. The print edition is split into
three volumes only because a single bound book would be too long to
handle comfortably.

**This volume**, *Industry Practice*, opens with compliance and
ethics (de-identification, de-identification in practice, and
ethics beyond compliance). It then covers statistical analysis
plans, testing and continuous integration, and the pharmaceutical
industry chapters (clinical data standards and SAS). It builds on
Volume 1
and is the recommended addition for pharmaceutical-track students,
alongside the one-quarter core path described in the preface.

**Volume 1**, *Data, Toolkit, and a First Look*, opens with the
two worked case studies and the HF-HOME capstone as a preview,
then covers why reproducible research matters, team science, the
toolkit, and working with data. It comes before this volume and is
assumed throughout.

**Volume 2**, *Documents, Environments, and Communication*, covers
documents and environments, communicating a finished analysis, and
federal requirements. It also carries the book's full reference
apparatus: the glossary, cheat sheets, the instructor guide, and
the rest of the appendices. If you need any of those while reading
this volume, they are in Volume 2.

Cross-references within this volume work as usual. A reference to
material in another volume is written as plain text, using that
volume's own chapter numbers, for example 'Chapter 3 ('renv for
Package Management') in Volume 2'. We do this because a printed
volume cannot link into a book it is not bound with.
